title: 3.6.13 Lab: Nested-Structure Mutation
description: Show that a spread copy is only one level deep: change a nested array inside the copy and the original still changes. Then fix it with a deep copy. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Copy the outer object with spread
steps.instructions: Create an object that contains a nested array (for example, a student with a list of scores). Make a shallow copy with the object spread syntax: a new object with the same keys.

steps.title: Change the nested array inside the copy
steps.instructions: Push a new value into the nested array of the copy. Then log both the copy and the original. Notice the original changed too, because a shallow copy still shares the nested array.

steps.title: Make a deep copy instead
steps.instructions: Use structuredClone to make a copy that goes all the way down. Change the nested array inside that copy, then log both again to prove the original is now untouched.
